# N18: Size: 1,000, 5,000 and 30,000 rows are checked within 3, 8 and 20 seconds, the page never stops for more than 200 ms, and the preview has fewer than 3,000 elements

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/19-import-large.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured.

## What it checks

N18 (b): size (IM6; docs/design/import/spec.md section 10). With 1,000, 5,000 and 30,000 generated rows, checking finishes within 3 s, 8 s and 20 s; no task on the page's thread is longer than 200 ms while it runs (the engine is in the import's worker); the preview has fewer than 3,000 elements. ("14 rows with one typo are one group" is held by src/domain/importSpeed.test.ts; N18 (a), the round trip, by src/domain/roundtrip.test.ts.)

## Where it looks

- 1440 × 900, as amara, at `/data/import`

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day.

## What it reports as wrong

- {k} rows: no preview after {Math.round(took / 1000)} s
- {k} rows: checked in {(took / 1000).toFixed(1)} s, over {budget / 1000} s
- {k} rows: the page stopped for {long.join(', ')} ms
- {k} rows: the preview has {els} elements
